pages.title: Ordinal Recursor
pages.text: Counts past infinity: takes a limit, adds one, and keeps going - omega, omega plus one, omega times two, omega squared, epsilon-naught...$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Builds the ordinals from $(item)Ordinal Shards$() mined in the $(thing)Transfinite Hierarchy$(): omega, epsilon-naught, omega-one - and the cardinals from them: aleph-one and the inaccessible cardinal that Absolute Infinity needs.
Note: ordinals measure order (first, second... omega-th), cardinals measure size. Omega plus one is a longer line than omega, yet no bigger - both are aleph-null. Infinity is unkind to intuition.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Aleph-One, Cardinal Shard, Epsilon-Naught, Omega, Omega-One.
A piece of the order in which infinities come.$(br2)Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Ordinal Shard$(): Absolute Notes III, Epsilon-Naught, Omega, Ordinal Recursor
